title: CLASSIC DISCO FUNK | Groovy French House for Long Evenings
description:
🔵 READY FOR THE DUB SIDE OF HOUSE?
First session this Friday → https://www.youtube.com/@sleeve_sessions 

Join to Groovix Patreon!: https://www.patreon.com/cw/GroovixDisco 

💿 Long evenings have their own logic. They ask for music that can hold the pace without losing the groove — and classic disco funk has been doing exactly that for decades. Add groovy French house and you get Groovix.

Classic disco funk is heritage music: the basslines that defined a generation, the rhythmic patterns that became the foundation of everything that came after. Groovy French house brings it into the present — filtered, considered, and with enough contemporary production to make it feel new without making it feel different.

This session honors the past without living in it. A long evening mix that earns every minute.

Sixty minutes of classic disco funk and groovy French house for long evenings that go exactly as long as they should.
